title: Nebius furthers European expansion with $10 billion AI data centre in Finland
title_zh: Nebius 斥资 100 亿美元在芬兰建立人工智能数据中心，进一步推进欧洲扩张
summary: AI infrastructure firm Nebius Group on Tuesday said it was continuing its rapid European ‌expansion with a 310-megawatt data centre in Finland, which would be one ‌of the continent's largest with an estimated value of more than $10 billion as demand for AI computing ​grows.
summary_zh: 人工智能基础设施公司 Nebius Group 周二表示，它将继续在欧洲快速扩张，在芬兰建立一个 310 兆瓦的数据中心，随着人工智能计算需求的增长，该数据中心将成为欧洲大陆最大的数据中心之一，估计价值超过 100 亿美元。

title: Big Tech's $635 billion AI spending faces energy shock test, S&P Global says
title_zh: 标准普尔全球表示，大型科技公司 6350 亿美元的人工智能支出面临能源冲击考验
summary: Massive investments in artificial intelligence that underpinned record runs in equities face a major ‌hurdle as the Middle East crisis clouds prospects for growth ‌and energy costs, said Melissa Otto, head of research at S&P Global Visible Alpha.
summary_zh: S&P Global Visible Alpha 研究主管梅丽莎·奥托 (Melissa Otto) 表示，由于中东危机给增长前景和能源成本蒙上阴影，支撑股市创纪录运行的人工智能大规模投资面临重大障碍。

title: Microsoft plans $1 billion investment in Thailand, Thai government says

summary_zh: 泰国政府在一份声明中表示，微软计划未来两年在泰国投资 10 亿美元用于云服务和人工智能基础设施。
